gizmo.title: Kēmu mahara
gizmo.description: Hurihia ngā kāri hei kimi takirua. Whakatakiruatia tētahi kupu me tōna tikanga kia whakaatu te ōritenga i te māramatanga, whakamahia rānei ētahi kuputuhi, atahanga ōrite e rua.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Te tohu ka whakaaturia ki te pane, hei tauira: Whakahāngaitia te kupu ki tōna mahi.

configure.title: Ngā takirua
configure.description: E rua ngā kāri o ia takirua e hāngai ana ki a rāua anō, ko te nuinga he kupu me tōna tikanga. Me whai kuputuhi, atahanga, ērā e rua rānei tētahi taha.

advanced.title: Tae arotahi
advanced.description: He tae kōwhiri mō te maramara pane, ngā tuarā kāri me te pātene.
